styles.name: Art Deco
styles.description: A streamlined ornamental mascot built from symmetrical masses, stepped geometry, and restrained metallic accents.

instructions.materials: Use polished flat illustration with lacquer-like color fields and a few controlled metallic inlay accents.
instructions.forms: Build a compact character from streamlined curves, stepped planes, and balanced geometric body masses.
instructions.linework: Use clean tapered contours and a few parallel decorative lines aligned to the character anatomy.
instructions.shading: Shade with broad planar value bands and restrained metallic highlights rather than soft photographic modeling.
instructions.palette: Choose deep contrasting body colors with one metallic accent and stable high-value facial features.
instructions.texture: Keep surfaces sleek with limited geometric inlay or fan-shaped markings confined to the body.
instructions.rendering: Render an isolated ornamental character with no architectural backdrop, border frame, lettering, or external sunburst.

negative_constraints: Do not replace the mascot with a poster, skyscraper, or decorative title treatment.
Avoid needle-thin ornament, detached rays, and symmetry changes to approved asymmetric markings.

limitations: Decorative symmetry must remain subordinate to established identity and required asymmetric features.
